listing.name: Gears of War 2 — Gears of War 2 — native PC port (unofficial) (santiquiroz)
listing.summary: Upstream reports Act 1 gameplay. Android slows heavily under sustained load, and internet co-op remains experimental. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own Gears of War 2 Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Retail title 4D53082D; default.xex plus GearGame.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract the Windows runtime ZIP and supply your own retail default.xex and GearGame folder. An unfinished Android APK is offered separately.

warnings: Upstream reports Act 1 gameplay. Android slows heavily under sustained load, and internet co-op remains experimental.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

references.title: Set up the upstream Android app
references.instruction: Get gow2-recomp-0.4.6-android-arm64.apk from the project's v0.4.6 release. Use ARM64 Android 10 or later with Vulkan and room for a full copy of your own retail Xbox 360 game. Choose game folder or Choose .iso file to import it. Use the Device Options gear for settings. If the game closes unexpectedly, long-press its app icon and choose Launch options for recovery.
